reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters, the last an unnamed group, stand at the first level and all say «قالوا» from Abu Usama.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو كريب، وعبد بن حميد، وغير، واحد، قالوا أخبرنا أبو أسامة

reasons.claim: The chain runs on through al-Hasan and Abu Sabra to Farwa, who tells of coming to the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو سبرة النخعي، عن فروة بن مسيك المرادي، قال أتيت النبي

reasons.claim: The Ibn Abbas line has no transmitters of its own and is a remark, not a route.
reasons.quote: وروي هذا عن ابن عباس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

reasons.claim: The report relays only Hafs's habit of how he introduced Ja'far, so the words relayed are Hafs's own and he is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن حفص بن غياث، أنه كان إذا حدثنا عن جعفر بن محمد (عليه السلام)، قال: حدثني خير الجعافر

reasons.claim: Ja'far is only named and described inside the account of Hafs's habit; he says nothing in this report, so he is not a link (ruling 4).
reasons.quote: حدثني خير الجعافر جعفر بن محمد

reasons.claim: The five transmitters before Hafs are written in order, each with «حدثنا».
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن أحمد السناني، قال: حدثنا محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: The report is Hafs's habit of introducing Ja'far; Ja'far speaks no words here and is not a link.

reviews.uncertainty_note: One could read the report as Hafs relaying from Ja'far, but no saying of Ja'far is given.

reasons.claim: One chain of four links, the second written only as «أبي».
reasons.quote: وحدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا شعبة، عن حميد بن نافع

reasons.claim: «جميعا» joins the two reports carried, not routes, and «نحو حديث محمد بن جعفر» is a bare comparison remark.
The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the saying alone.
One chain of five links ends at Jabir, whose words about Bilal are the report.
reasons.quote: عن سماك بن حرب، عن جابر بن سمرة، قال كان بلال

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters from Ibn Idris all pass on from al-Maqburi.
reasons.quote: عن عبيد الله، وابن، جريج وابن إسحاق ومالك بن أنس عن المقبري

reasons.claim: Ibn Umar is asked and answers, so he is the last link (ruling 3).
Ibn Abi Umayr narrates from Aban and an unnamed other, both from the Imam, who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبَانٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

reasons.claim: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the ruling alone.
Al-Sakuni narrates by his own unstated isnad to the Prophet, who ends the chain and is not a link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: «بإسناده» is a gap rather than a pointer to an earlier report, but its kind changes no route.
